text_units.verbatim_text: Supplementary Table 6 Practical guidance on the use of the sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 inhibitors dapagliflozin and empagliflozin in patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fractiona

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: To improve QOL, reduce the risk of HF hospitalization, and increase survival.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Patients with HFrEF (regardless of concomitant diabetes mellitus).

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Known allergic reaction/other adverse reaction (drug-specific).

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Pregnancy/risk of pregnancy and breastfeeding period.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: eGFR <20 mL/min/1.73 m2.\*

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Symptoms of hypotension or a SBP <95 mmHg.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Type 1 diabetes mellitus is not an absolute contraindication, but an individual risk of ketoacidosis should be taken into account when starting this therapy.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Glycosuria (as the consequence of dapagliflozin action) may predispose to fungal genito-urinary infections.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Drug interactions to look out for: Insulin, sulfonylurea derivatives and other antidiabetic drugs predisposing to hypoglycaemia.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Thiazides and loop diuretics predisposing to excessive diuresis, dehydration, symptomatic hypotension, and prerenal renal failure.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Dapagliflozin: starting (and target) dose 10 mg o.d.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Empagliflozin: starting (and target) dose 10 mg o.d.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Check renal function when starting the therapy and monitor regularly. eGFR is known to dip slightly after initiation but the SGLT2 inhibitors appear to be reno-protective.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Monitor glycaemia regularly, particularly when a patient is diabetic. Consider modification of other diabetic drugs.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Identify the risk factors predisposing to ketoacidosis and eliminate them if possible.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Monitor fluid balance regularly, particularly when a patient is taking diuretics, is old and/or frail. Consider an adjustment of diuretic therapy and fluid intake.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: A specialist HF nurse may assist with education of the patient, follow-up (in person or by telephone), and biochemical monitoring.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Patients should be monitored in the context of symptoms and signs of genito-urinary fungal infections.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Other diabetic drugs (particularly, insulin and/or sulfonylurea derivatives) may predispose to hypoglycaemia; in this case, the diabetic treatment strategy needs to be modified.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: SGLT2 inhibitors may intensify the diuresis, particularly when accompanied by Sac/Val and diuretic therapy.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Fluid balance needs to be monitored. Diuretic doses along with fluid intake should be balanced in order to avoid dehydration, symptomatic hypotension, and prerenal renal failure.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Elderly and frail patients are at particular risk of developing these complications.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Explain expected benefits (see WHY?)

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Treatment is given to improve QOL, to prevent worsening of HF leading to hospital admission, and to increase survival (to reduce the risk of CV and all-cause deaths).

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Improvement in QOL occurs within a few weeks to a few months of starting treatment.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Due to action of SGLT2 inhibitors, glycosuria is an expected finding on urinalysis.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Patients should be made aware of the risk of dehydration, hypotension, hypoglycaemia, ketoacidosis, and fungal genito-urinary infections, and in these cases they should contact the physician/nurse.
